description: Machine-readable manifest for the RS-0003.5E1 real-production regression suite. Every entry names one examples/*.rhs fixture and the reasons it exists. See examples/baselines.json for the committed geometry expectations this manifest's `file` values correspond to, and tools/test-examples-regression.mjs for the automated checks that consume both files.

examples.description: Original preserved fixture: single short text layer, default centerline/outline mode, no auto-fit.
Original preserved fixture: longer two-word name with auto-fit enabled.
Short first name in the block (Courier Prime) font, light cream cup, front wrap.
Long two-word name at a text height that exceeds the canvas, forcing the auto-fit rescale pass; dark navy cup, wide wrap.
Script font (Great Vibes) name on a white cup.
Three-letter monogram in block font, outline (centerline) sampling, on a small square canvas, black cup.
Two-letter monogram in block font, dense fill sampling, small square canvas, mint cup.
Dedicated front-wrap + light (white) cup coverage case.
Dedicated wider-wrap + dark (black) cup coverage case.
Single circle shape layer, no text, full wrap, navy cup.
Single rectangle shape layer, no text, half wrap, gray cup.
Text layer plus an overlapping circle frame layer, exercising cross-layer proximity dedupe.
Text layer plus a rectangle frame layer, wide wrap, pink cup.
Text, circle, and rectangle layers together; the rectangle layer is visible:false, so this fixture is the suite's dedicated total-layer-count vs visible-layer-count regression case.
